title: Unknown Role Class Negative Fixture
description: EXT-28 / ADR-0155 §4 negative fixture. The `role` value `witness` is not in the closed PartyRoleClass enum (coEqual | asymmetricPrimary | asymmetricSecondary | guardianFor). Domain-specific party metadata (notary, witness, etc.) MUST live in `extensions`, NOT as a new role-class value. This document MUST fail schema validation per MP-02.
